positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Created new Javalin-based handlers and services for PDF documents to incorporate file/form data access objects and speed up retrieval of application questions and client responses by 85%
• Integrated Apache PDFBox with application PDFs to directly extract question fields and inject client answers 
• Transitioned MongoDB documents into refactored PDF storage system with Java scripts using REST APIs
• Wrote unit and integration tests using JUnit to validate functionality of new backend handlers and services

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:

• Set up auto page generation for new events/newspapers with Gatsby Node API to reduce upload time by 70%
• Used styled-components library to design website with custom CSS styles and responsive web design

projects.title: Cloud-based Search Engine (Goooooogle)
projects.description:
• Designed Spark-based dynamic web server deployed on Amazon EC2 with sessions and request concurrency
• Built distributed crawler to generate a corpus of 1000000 pages and indexer to create inverted word index
• Implemented Apache Spark-based analytics engine to batch process crawling, indexing, and ranking operations
• Used word lemmatization, pre-computed tf-idf scores, and PageRanks to optimize and speed up search queries

projects.title: Spotify Data Exploration Website (DataTune)
projects.description:
• Composed SQL queries to organize Spotify song/artist data stored on MySQL database using AWS RDS
• Connected React frontend with Node.js backend to visualize query results using Material UI components
• Utilized React Simple Maps to create world map page that shows a country’s song/album details on hover
